reverse_expectations.method: Hold year-1 revenue at 0.9B, owner-margin path from 2% to 16%, required return at 9%, terminal multiple at 22x and the same first-four-year 45M annual capital cash adjustment; solve one constant revenue growth rate for years 2-10 that equates model value to the reference price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: A conditional price-justifying combination, not the market's unique forecast. The current price embeds modest revenue growth only if the company eventually achieves a 16% owner-cash margin after substantial capital intensity.
